recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work on actual multi-version IG publication support or richer construction guidance should be handled by a new issue or tooling-specific work rather than by changing FHIR-39186 beyond its approved disposition.
issue_request: FHIR-39186 was a Published FHIR-I R5 ballot change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for more detail in the Multi-Version Implementation Guides section. The final resolution was to correct the example property from "fhirVersions" to "fhirVersion" and add a dragon warning that current publication tooling did not yet support creating such IGs and that more guidance would be forthcoming.
initial_application: The explicit source commit d1cce35cdd4058607b0a2446b50d6038d333f203, dated 2022-12-06 and titled "FHIR-39186 More detail needed for Multi-Version Implementation Guides", changed source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml by making the example say "fhirVersion" and inserting the requested warning text.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists implementationguide as an active resource, so source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml is current build input. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-11-14 corroborate the Persuasive with Mod 7-0-0 vote. A targeted Zulip FTS query found no relevant discussion changing the Jira/source conclusion, and the only remaining source occurrence of "fhirVersions" is package metadata documentation in source/packages.html, not the ImplementationGuide example.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already links ImplementationGuide.fhirVersion, uses "fhirVersion" in the JSON example, and includes the requested dragon warning.
